label: Extron DMP 128 FlexPlus C V AT

_avail.description: ProDSP Dante Digital Matrix Processor w/ 12 AEC and VoIP

portsSource.label: Extron DMP 128 FlexPlus C V AT

ports.label: Mic/Line In 1
ports.notes: 6-pole 3.5mm captive screw, balanced/unbalanced, +48VDC phantom power switchable per input. 2 channels per connector — modeled per-channel.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 2
ports.notes: 6-pole 3.5mm captive screw, balanced/unbalanced, +48VDC phantom power switchable per input. 2 channels per connector — modeled per-channel.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 3
ports.notes: 6-pole 3.5mm captive screw, balanced/unbalanced, +48VDC phantom power switchable per input. 2 channels per connector — modeled per-channel.

ports.label: Mic/Line In 4
ports.notes: 6-pole 3.5mm captive screw, balanced/unbalanced, +48VDC phantom power switchable per input. 2 channels per connector — modeled per-channel.

ports.label: VoIP (SIP)
ports.notes: Dedicated 10/100/1000 Base-T port for SIP 2.0 VoIP signaling (up to 8 concurrent SIP lines). Software-isolated from main LAN.

ports.label: Dante / AES67 1
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (2-port internal switch).

ports.label: Dante / AES67 2
ports.notes: 1 Gbps Dante / AES67 audio network port (2-port internal switch).

ports.label: Digital I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on a 3-pole captive screw (In/GND/Out per channel).

ports.label: Digital I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on a 3-pole captive screw (In/GND/Out per channel).

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 host control on a 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw (38400 baud default).

ports.label: ACP Bus
ports.notes: ACP audio control panel bus on a 4-pole 3.5mm captive screw — supports up to 8 ACP panels (+12V/+S/-S/G). Mapped to `serial` SignalType (no `acp`/`ebus` type in src/types.ts).

ports.label: EXP
ports.notes: Proprietary 16×16 bidirectional digital audio expansion port over shielded CAT6 (24-bit / 48 kHz uncompressed). Used to link two DMP units or link to a DTP CrossPoint matrix. Mapped to `aes` SignalType per session 5 XMP 240 convention (no `extron-exp` SignalType in src/types.ts).

ports.label: USB Audio (Rear)
ports.notes: Rear-panel USB Mini-B for USB audio bridge (USB 2.0 high-speed). Up to 4 channels of digital audio in/out.

ports.label: USB Config (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for DSP Configurator / PCS configuration (USB 2.0).
